steps.title: Mark four sterile PCR tubes as 1, 10⁻¹ 10⁻² and…
steps.description: Mark four sterile PCR tubes as 1, 10⁻¹ 10⁻² and 10⁻³.

steps.title: Add 90 µL of original sample to the first tube…
steps.description: Add 90 µL of original sample to the first tube. Add 90 µL of buffer to rest tubes.

steps.title: Add 10 µL of the original sample into the 10⁻¹…
steps.description: Add 10 µL of the original sample into the 10⁻¹ tube and mix well by pipetting.

steps.title: Transfer 10 µL from the 10⁻¹ tube into the 10⁻²…
steps.description: Transfer 10 µL from the 10⁻¹ tube into the 10⁻² tube, mix well. Repeat the process sequentially for 10⁻³ tubes.
